nodes.name: next.config.ts
nodes.summary: Next.js 15 configuration with App Router, TypeScript, React 19, Turbopack, image optimization (domains: MinIO, localhost), internationalization (vi, en), middleware for auth, and bundle analyzer. Configures rewrites for AI service proxy and API routes.

nodes.name: postcss.config.mjs
nodes.summary: PostCSS configuration with Tailwind CSS v4, Autoprefixer, and CSS nesting plugin. Processes global styles and component-scoped CSS for the HRM Website design system.

nodes.name: test-admin-browser.mjs
nodes.summary: Playwright browser test script for admin panel: navigates login, verifies dashboard loads, checks sidebar navigation, tests user management CRUD, and validates role-based access control. Runs headless in CI.

nodes.name: test-session-modal.mjs
nodes.summary: Playwright test for session management modal: verifies session list displays, tests revoke session action, checks concurrent session limit enforcement, and validates toast notifications.

nodes.name: test-shift-and-search.mjs
nodes.summary: Playwright test for work shift management and employee search: creates shift templates, assigns shifts, tests date range filtering, verifies search autocomplete, and checks pagination.

nodes.name: package.json
nodes.summary: HRM Website package.json: Next.js 15, React 19, TypeScript 5, Tailwind CSS 4, Radix UI, React Hook Form, Zod, Axios, SWR, date-fns, Lucide React. Scripts: dev, build, start, lint, test, test:e2e. Workspace dependencies: @hrm/ui, @hrm/api-client.

nodes.name: tsconfig.json
nodes.summary: TypeScript 5 configuration: strict mode, path aliases (@/*, @hrm/*), target ES2022, moduleResolution bundler, JSX preserve, incremental builds. Extends base config from turbo repo.

nodes.name: .env.example
nodes.summary: Frontend environment variables template: NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL, NEXT_PUBLIC_AI_SERVICE_URL, NEXT_PUBLIC_MINIO_ENDPOINT, NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_NAME, AUTH_SECRET, NEXTAUTH_URL, GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID, GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET.

nodes.name: tailwind.config.ts
nodes.summary: Tailwind CSS v4 configuration: custom color palette (primary, secondary, semantic), spacing scale, typography (font families), border radius, shadows, dark mode class strategy, and plugin integrations (forms, typography, animate).

nodes.name: middleware.ts
nodes.summary: Next.js middleware for authentication: validates JWT access token, refreshes via refresh token cookie, redirects unauthenticated to login, enforces role-based route access (admin, manager, employee), and sets security headers.
